story.fullStory:
Cliff Richard's "Dreamin'" — original release 1980. "Dreamin'" ("Dreaming" in US) is a song recorded by Cliff Richard from his 1980 album, I'm No Hero.

Artist: Cliff Richard · Title: Dreamin' · Album: Dreamin' · Year: 1980 · Genre: Christmas Music · Path: /Users/bobhopp/DJ MEDIA/VIDEO/1980's/Cliff Richard - Dreamin'.mp4.

The track was the first of three singles released and was the biggest hit from the album, becoming a top-ten hit in numerous countries including the UK and the US where it became his third and last top ten hit.

Release and reception
"Dreamin'" was composed by Alan Tarney with lyrics by Leo Sayer, whose own hit, a cover of "More Than I Can Say", was on the charts concurrently with "Dreaming" during the last four months of 1980.
